source_routes.name: About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up v2

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

Coverage validation remains source_scan_complete false with zero official candidates.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact ZIP and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: Ofcom received data from 52 fixed-network and 18 fixed-wireless-access providers.
Providers submitted data for premises where an end-user could order a fixed broadband service on their network.

guard_streams.write_limit: Provider coverage scope is not proof of service at an individual parcel.

facts.detail: The fixed coverage and take-up files use a January 2026 snapshot.
Fixed coverage files and the local-authority full-fibre take-up file are separate products.

guard_streams.write_limit: Coverage availability and active-line take-up must not be conflated.

facts.detail: Coverage products are provided for UK and nations, local authorities, constituencies, output areas and postcodes.
The downloadable full-fibre take-up product is provided for local and unitary authorities.

guard_streams.write_limit: Local-authority take-up cannot be assigned to a postcode or parcel.

facts.detail: The residential and commercial premise base uses Ordnance Survey AddressBase Premium and Islands products.
The January 2026 snapshot uses AddressBase Epoch 123.

guard_streams.write_limit: Premise-base provenance does not create a parcel-level broadband observation.

facts.detail: The UK-and-nations file separates all, residential and commercial premise types.
The UK-and-nations file separates total, urban and rural classifications.

guard_streams.write_limit: National dimension rows are aggregate context only.

facts.detail: The speed taxonomy includes premise base, unclassified, below 2 Mbit/s, and below 10 Mbit/s download or 1 Mbit/s upload.
The taxonomy also includes at least 10, 24, 30, 100 and 300 Mbit/s, full fibre and gigabit capable.

guard_streams.write_limit: Taxonomy labels are availability classes rather than measured parcel throughput.

facts.detail: The UK-and-nations file provides both percentage covered and number of premises covered.
The file records Jan-26 as the snapshot date.

guard_streams.write_limit: Aggregate counts and percentages cannot substitute for exact postcode rows.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data v2 and Spring 2026 update

facts.detail: Full-fibre take-up uses active lines that provide broadband service to residential or business customers.
Spring 2026 reports 12.4 million full-fibre connections, equal to 47 percent of premises with full-fibre access.

guard_streams.write_limit: An active-line take-up ratio is not a coverage percentage for a target parcel.

facts.detail: One take-up field divides active full-fibre services by premises with full-fibre coverage.
A second take-up field divides active full-fibre services by all premises in the local authority.

guard_streams.write_limit: The two denominator definitions must remain distinct.

facts.detail: A local-authority take-up percentage can decline when coverage expands faster than active connections.
Ofcom notes that consumers may need time to learn of availability or wait for an existing contract to end.

guard_streams.write_limit: A lower ratio does not imply fewer active connections or reduced parcel coverage.

facts.detail: Detailed fixed coverage is published at local authority, Westminster constituency, devolved constituency, output-area and postcode levels.
Each detailed level has all-premises and residential-only coverage families.

guard_streams.write_limit: All-premises and residential-only denominators must not be mixed.

facts.detail: Postcode files contain availability percentages including SFBB, UFBB and gigabit fields.
Premise-count fields for covered or unable premises are documented for all detailed levels except postcode.

guard_streams.write_limit: Postcode percentages cannot be converted into exact premise counts without a valid denominator.
